thread:
rachel_l: hi all, brand new here. trying to enroll my MacBook Pro into MDM but the web flow errors with 'Could not verify server identity'. macOS 13.6.2. any tips? :wave:
it_support: welcome @rachel_l! first quick checks: run `sw_vers -productVersion` and `security find-certificate -a -c \"Redwood Internal CA\"` and paste results. also are you on home wifi or office?
rachel_l: sw_vers: 13.6.2
security returned nothing. i'm on home wifi.
ops_bot: checklist: 1) try phone hotspot 2) ensure system clock set to automatic 3) install onboarding cert if present in your welcome email
dylan_e: if the cert is missing we can push a system-level root installer, but that requires admin. do you have local admin?
rachel_l: no admin yet. i need brew and docker for my dev setup — can i get temporary sudo?
it_support: granted 3-hour admin token via DM for onboarding tasks. install the root to System keychain and reboot, then retry enrollment. i'll stand by.
rachel_l: installed cert and rebooted, enrollment now asks to approve the management profile and shows a consent-code prompt. i never got a code.
it_support: consent codes are one-time; generating now for serial C02M4Z8QH7Y. sending via DM.
sam_devlead: welcome! once enrolled ping #dev-env for the bootstrap script so you can get toolchain and dotfiles set up.
rachel_l: entered code, profile approved, enrollment success. `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault Off". will FileVault be forced? :lock:
it_support: our policy enforces FileVault. sometimes macOS defers enable until first login. i'm pushing a remote enable now; you'll get a prompt and we will escrow the recovery key. ops_bot: Deploy job 9842 queued: push/filevault-enable -> target C02M4Z8QH7Y
rachel_l: prompt came up and enabling now. also completed brew + docker installs. thanks for the quick help everyone! i'll reply when admin token can be revoked.
it_support: admin token will auto-expire in 3 hours. if you want immediate removal reply here and we'll revoke sooner. marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
